description: What the shell needs in order to get unsaved orders onto disk before the window closes, and to hand the releases page to a browser. There was no capability file at all until now, because commands this application defines itself are not gated by the ACL; onCloseRequested and destroy are core-plugin calls and are refused without one. core:default is Tauri's own baseline and carries the event listening; destroy is not in it, being the one call that ends the window, so it is named here. opener:allow-open-url is scoped to this repository rather than granted outright: the update check needs exactly one address, and a webview that can ask the operating system to open anything is a larger thing to own than that.
